entries.title: Isaiah 53:1
segments: ¶Who would have had faith in the word which has come to our ears, and to whom had the arm of the Lord been unveiled?

entries.title: Isaiah 53:2
segments: For his growth was like that of a delicate plant before him, and like a root out of a dry place: he had no grace of form, to give us pleasure;

entries.title: Isaiah 53:3
segments: Men made sport of him, turning away from him; he was a man of sorrows, marked by disease; and like one from whom men's faces are turned away, he was looked down on, and we put no value on him.

entries.title: Isaiah 53:4
segments: ¶But it was our pain he took, and our diseases were put on him: while to us he seemed as one diseased, on whom God's punishment had come.

entries.title: Isaiah 53:5
segments: But it was for our sins he was wounded, and for our evil doings he was crushed: he took the punishment by which we have peace, and by his wounds we are made well.

entries.title: Isaiah 53:6
segments: We all went wandering like sheep; going every one of us after his desire; and the Lord put on him the punishment of us all.

entries.title: Isaiah 53:7
segments: Men were cruel to him, but he was gentle and quiet; as a lamb taken to its death, and as a sheep before those who take her wool makes no sound, so he said not a word.

entries.title: Isaiah 53:8
segments: They took away from him help and right, and who gave a thought to his fate? for he was cut off from the land of the living: he came to his death for the sin of my people.

entries.title: Isaiah 53:9
segments: And they put his body into the earth with sinners, and his last resting-place was with the evil-doers, though he had done no wrong, and no deceit was in his mouth.

entries.title: Isaiah 53:10
segments: ¶And the Lord was pleased...see a seed, long life, ...will do well in his hand. ...

entries.title: Isaiah 53:11
segments: ...made clear his righteousness before men...had taken their sins on himself.

entries.title: Isaiah 53:12
segments: For this cause he will have a heritage with the great, and he will have a part in the goods of war with the strong, because he gave up his life, and was numbered with the evil-doers; taking on himself the sins of the people, and making prayer for the wrongdoers.
